verdict.rationale: Angular's docs describe it as a platform where everything works together through first-party modules for routing, and a community user independently praised the built-in @angular/router. One report says the beta Angular 2 router lacked child-route data passing and active-route checks, but that describes an old pre-release version, not the current router. missing for 10: in-depth first-party router documentation (route config, guards, lazy loading, child routes), and current hands-on corroboration that the integration is seamless.
